p: nations: He prophecies of the destruction of the Edomites and other nations which were enemies to the Church.
destroyed them: God has determined in his counsel and has given sentence for their destruction.
shall be dissolved: He speaks this in respect to man's judgment, who in great fear and horrible troubles, think that heaven and earth perishes.
bathed in heaven: I have determined in my secret counsel and in the heavens to destroy them till my sword is weary with shedding blood.
my curse: They had an opinion of holiness, because they came from the patriarch Isaac, but in effect were cursed by God, and enemies to his Church as the papists are.
lambs and goats: That is, both of young and old, poor and rich of his enemies.
Bozrah: That famous city will be consumed as a sacrifice burnt to ashes.
unicorns shall come down with them: The mighty and rich will be as well destroyed as the inferiors.
brimstone: He alludes to the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Ge 19:24.
and the bittern shall possess it: Read Isa 13:21, Zep 2:14.
confusion: In vain will any man go about to build it again.
They shall call her nobles to: Meaning, here will be neither order nor policy nor state of commonwealth.
meet with the wild beasts of: Read Isa 13:21.
shall the great owl make her: Signifying that Idumea would be a horrible desolation and barren wilderness.
book of the LORD: That is, in the law where such curses are threatened against the wicked.
these shall fail: That is, beasts and souls.
mouth it hath commanded: That is, the mouth of the Lord.
lot for them: He has given the beasts and souls Idumea for an inheritance.
